newsitem.title: USA: NJ managed care car insurance option to lapse.
newsitem.headline: NJ managed care car insurance option to lapse.

text.p: New Jersey Insurance Commissioner Elizabeth Randall announced on Thursday that the regulation she proposed in July to establish a managed care option for auto insurance carriers will be allowed to lapse.

The commissioner said her legal authority was shaky and she recommended the legislature rewrite the requirement that consumers pay a deductible. Without that change in the law a managed care option would be unattractive, she said. The Trial Lawyers Association said it welcomed Randall's decision, saying it believed that managed care in auto insurance is not in the consumers' best interests.
